uca_sentences: A man wearing a hat and a black and white plaid shirt was leaning over the counter and groping for something.
The man took out a black pistol and pointed it at the man in black at the opposite counter.
The man at the counter turned around
The man with the gun took the gun back.
The man in plaid shirt took away a bottle of Coke on the counter
The man in plaid shirt took what the man at the counter handed him and turned around to leave.

witness_A.viewpoint: close by, inside, a few metres away
witness_A.statement: I saw a man leaning over the counter, took away a bottle of Coke, and then turned around to leave. I'm pretty sure he was wearing a black and white plaid shirt and a hat. He took out a black pistol and pointed it at the man in black clothes who was behind the counter. The man in black clothes turned around.

witness_B.viewpoint: far away, looking in from outside
witness_B.statement: I saw a man in a blue and white plaid shirt who robbed the place. He took out a black pistol and pointed it at the man in black. The robber took the gun back and took away a bottle of Coke. I'm pretty sure the robber leaned over the counter and took what the man at the counter handed him. I'm not sure if the man being robbed turned around. The weapon was a pistol held by the man in the plaid shirt.

witness_C.statement: I saw a man who robbed the place. He was groping for something, took out a black pistol, took the gun back, took away a bottle of Coke, and took what the man at the counter handed him. Another man, wearing black clothes, was being robbed and turned around. I think there was a weapon, maybe a pistol. I'm pretty sure there was a bottle of Coke. I'm not sure about the vehicle type, but I think it was a white van.
